name: headroom
description: Your Claude plan limits, a forecast of when you'll run out, and your context window, live in a band above the prompt. Compacts in one click, automatically, or when Claude picks the moment, and keeps the prompt cache warm

cacheTtl.title: Keep cache warm: lifetime
cacheTtl.description: The prompt cache lifetime a new chat's Keep cache warm starts with. auto follows Claude Code's own choice (1h on a subscription within its limits, 5m on an API key or in overage); 5m or 1h sets it while warming is on. A 1h write costs 2x input instead of 1.25x.

idle5m.title: Keep cache warm: idle refreshes, 5m
idle5m.description: Refreshes a 5-minute cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs a $0.05 expected saving.

idle1h.title: Keep cache warm: idle refreshes, 1h
idle1h.description: Refreshes a 1-hour cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs a $0.05 expected saving.

warmUntil.title: Keep cache warm: until a limit reaches %
warmUntil.description: No refresh is sent while the 5 Hour or Weekly limit is at or past this %: a refresh counts against your plan like any request.
